anteriores.texto: Quando os comandantes dos carros viram Josafá, disseram: “Ele é o rei de Israel”, e se voltaram contra ele para lutar. Josafá clamou, o SENHOR o ajudou, e Deus os desviou dele.
Quando os comandantes dos carros perceberam que ele não era o rei de Israel, deixaram de persegui-lo.

posteriores.texto: A batalha se intensificou naquele dia. O rei de Israel manteve-se de pé no carro diante de Arã até a tarde e morreu quando o sol se pôs.
Josafá, rei de Judá, voltou em paz para sua casa, em Jerusalém.

kjv.texto: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

vizinhos.32: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
vizinhos.34: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
